_comment: SINGLE SOURCE for the freshness subject -> producer mapping (AC7/AC8 of
tasks/gap-ac214-upgrade-face-refresh-and-mechanical-freshness-trigger).
WHY THIS FILE EXISTS: the evidence of the subjects below must stay within K delivery-face
commits of the develop tip (goal AC-214). Refreshing them is a real cross-machine PRODUCER
run, and before this file that mapping lived only in the prose of whichever one-off task was
closing the gap at the time. Cost, measured: the gap re-crossed 4 times in 5 days
(2026-09-13 x2, 2026-09-14 x2), each crossing closed by a manual re-run with no trigger.
WHO READS IT (one source, two readers -- never a second copy):
* plugin/scripts/freshness-producer-coverage-check.ts -- the completeness judge (which
subject has no registered producer at all);
* plugin/probes/freshness-refresh.md -- the routine probe (which producer to name in a
finding, and each producer's wall clock for the threshold arithmetic).
`wallclock_hours` is a MEASURED quantity, not an estimate: it is the end-to-end wall clock of
one producer run observed on this repo, and it feeds the probe's threshold
THRESHOLD_fraction = (wallclock_hours + interval_hours) * rate_per_hour / K. A wrong value
here moves a threshold, so each entry records where its number came from.
`preconditions` (optional) names ENVIRONMENTAL requirements a producer's subjects need BEFORE
re-running it can refresh them. It exists because 're-run the producer' is not always a complete
remedy: the session-delivery entry's subject only refreshes on a machine that already HAS a live
session whose settings allow inbound, which this repo does not control (measured 2026-09-15: host
C's only live session holds unidentified peers). Read it before filing a finding that says
'just re-run <producer id>' — that file is the probe's ONLY input for which producer to name.
_scope_note: A carrier record counts as a REFRESHABLE SUBJECT iff its `ac` matches subject_id_pattern AND it carries a top-level 40-hex build_sha. Measured on the real carrier 2026-09-14, that rule yields exactly the seven subjects below: GOAL-009-AC-204/206 match the pattern but carry no build_sha; GOAL-018-AC-257 carries a build_sha but not the GOAL-009 prefix.

producers._wallclock_measured: 20m36s end-to-end, measured on this repo (recorded in the AC-214 gap history; the coldstart face is the cheap half of the pair).

producers._same_run_as: coldstart-face — AC-205 由同一次运行的 ⑦ --ac205-session 腿产出，⛔ 不存在单独的命令。两条 producer 条目【共用同一条命令行】：改其中一处必须同时改另一处（行文相同的重复是这里唯一的真相源，本条 _same_run_as 就是它的指针）。
producers._wallclock_measured: 同 coldstart-face 的 20m36s 端到端实测 —— AC-205 腿在那次运行之内，没有单独测量，所以 ⛔ 不编一个更小的数（W 相同 ⇒ 探针的阈值算术不变，不会因为拆分而移动任何阈值）。
preconditions: 验证机上必须有一个【活】会话 —— 进程活着（kill(pid,0) 不抛 ESRCH ∧ procStart 相符）；⛔ 「socket 文件存在」不算（进程死后 socket 不被 unlink，见 verify-deliver-coldstart.sh 的 find_ac205_target_session 活性闸）。

【且】该会话的 settings 具备 permissions.defaultMode=bypassPermissions 或 crossSessionInbound=accept 之一（判据的直接量；SPEC-web-session-observability-and-control-2026-08-24.md §10.1 四样本单变量对照）。发送前即可检测：send-to-session.ts --pid <pid> --precheck 打印 hold-precheck=direct|will-hold|unknown。
两者皆无 ⇒ probe 被按 `Held peer message`（type:system/subtype:informational）扣下 ⇒ 本腿落痕 delivery_outcome=held、不落账。2026-09-15 实测 host C：其唯一活会话（cwd=/home/yale/work/archguard）两键皆无 ⇒ held。⛔ 这不是缺陷，是判据在工作。
⇒ 本前置【不由本仓库保证】（取决于验证机上别的会话的配置，那些会话属于别的项目）⇒ AC-205 不能与 coldstart-face 的其余四个主体同等对待：那四条「重跑即刷新」，本条【先要满足前置】才谈得上刷新（host B 满足 ⇒ 可产出；host C 不满足 ⇒ 产不出，且两种失败现在落痕不同形）。

producers._wallclock_measured: 2h, from THREE converging sources, ⚠️ with the honest caveat that a full end-to-end measurement is currently BLOCKED (see below): (a) the AC-214 task text's own worked example ('升级面约 2h'); (b) the measured record in that same text — the coldstart face measured 20m36s end-to-end, and the upgrade face is recorded as 跨机小时级 (the AC-239 half alone drives a real defect fix + fan-in + a full suite); (c) the MECHANICAL bound the producer imposes on itself — verify-deliver-coldstart.sh's AC239_POLL_SECS default 3600s, i.e. the e2e is *declared* to finish within 1h and times out (writing no record) beyond it. ⛔ CAVEAT, stated because an unmeasured input to a threshold is exactly what this task forbids elsewhere: the full end-to-end wall clock could not be MEASURED on 2026-09-14 because the upgrade face's AC-239 half is structurally unreachable — the shipped artifact carries no dist/driver-anchor.js, so `quay driver start` returns rc=1 in every installed layout (reproduced fail-closed text in the task's Resolution). The three sources above therefore BOUND W from below/around; if the true value is larger, the threshold is too small and the probe files too late, so this entry must be re-measured once that defect is fixed. ⚠️ Conservative direction check: W only ever INCREASES the threshold, so an over-estimate files early (safe, mild noise) and an under-estimate files late (loses the window) — re-measure before trusting the margin.

_not_registered_note: Subjects that appear in the carrier but are deliberately NOT registered here, so a future reader
* GOAL-009-AC-204 / GOAL-009-AC-206 -- written by the coldstart face but carry no build_sha,
so they fall outside the declared scope rule (they track driver/state readings, not
faces (browser render, goal-write, third-party install) writing the same carrier; the
AC-214 criterion does not track them and neither does this mapping.
